questions.question: Farmers in the Ethiopian highlands inspect their crops ______ the first seasonal rains begin in April.
questions.explanation: 'As soon as' is a subordinating conjunction of time used to indicate that an event occurs immediately after another specified event.

questions.question: The reading text notes that agroforestry contributes significantly to 'biodiversity' conservation. What is the closest contextual meaning of 'biodiversity'?

options.text: The variety of plant and animal species living in a particular habitat
The chemical composition of synthetic agricultural pesticides
The financial profit earned from timber export sales
The total volume of rainfall recorded annually

questions.explanation: 'Biodiversity' contextually refers to the variety and variability of living flora and fauna within an ecosystem.

questions.question: Despite severe budget constraints and public skepticism, the conservation committee decided to ______ its original environmental protection plan.
questions.explanation: The phrasal verb 'stick to' means to adhere firmly to a plan, rule, or decision without altering it.

questions.question: Complete the dialogue: Kebede: 'Community-based resource management empowers local residents.' Lemlem: '______; when local people own the land, conservation efforts succeed.'

options.text: That makes no sense at all

questions.explanation: 'I couldn't agree more' is a standard formal expression used to signal complete agreement with an opinion.

questions.question: Which of the following three-syllable words places its primary stress on the SECOND syllable?
questions.explanation: 'Department' has three syllables with primary stress on the second syllable (/dɪˈpɑːrt.mənt/). 'Telephone' and 'kindergarten' stress their first syllables.

questions.question: By the time the new reforestation guidelines ______ officially published next year, local communities ______ over one million indigenous saplings.
questions.explanation: In time clauses referring to future completion, the time clause uses Simple Present ('are') while the main clause requires Future Perfect ('will have planted').

questions.question: Trees in agroforestry systems help 'sequester' atmospheric carbon dioxide. What does 'sequester' mean in this ecological context?

options.text: Isolate, absorb, and store carbon safely away from the atmosphere
Release large volumes of toxic gas into the air
Burn plant residue during crop harvesting
Export unprocessed timber to overseas markets

questions.explanation: In environmental science, 'sequester' means to capture, absorb, and store carbon dioxide in plant biomass or soil over long periods.

questions.question: Solve the verbal analogy: ORNITHOLOGIST is to BIRD as ARCHAEOLOGIST is to ______.
questions.explanation: An ornithologist specializes in studying birds; similarly, an archaeologist specializes in studying ancient human artifacts and historical remains.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences contains a DANGLING MODIFIER?

options.text: Drooping and looking all dried out, the children watered the garden plants.
While the children were watering the garden plants, the flowers looked drooping and dried out.
Having finished their homework, the students watered the garden plants.
After inspecting the dry soil, the gardener watered the plants.

questions.explanation: In Option A, 'Drooping and looking all dried out' illogically modifies 'the children' (suggesting the children were drooping and dried out). This is a dangling modifier.

questions.question: According to the reading text on Natural Resource Management in Ethiopia, what distinguishes the Guassa area conservation system in North Shewa?

options.text: It is one of the oldest community-based resource management systems in Sub-Saharan Africa, operating under customary tenure rules.
It relies exclusively on foreign commercial timber companies for funding.
It was established in 2020 by international private investors.
It prohibits local residents from harvesting grass or pasturing livestock under any circumstances.

questions.explanation: Section 4C.2 notes that the Guassa conservation system is an ancient community-managed commons system operating for over 400 years under traditional governance.

questions.question: During the heated environmental debate, the young researcher stood up and ______ her colleagues when they faced unfair criticism.
questions.explanation: The three-word phrasal verb 'stick up for' means to defend, support, or speak in favor of someone facing criticism.

questions.question: Read the sentence: 'Using the Pythagorean Theorem, the complex math problem was easily solved.' Which option correctly revises this sentence to eliminate the dangling modifier?

options.text: Using the Pythagorean Theorem, the student easily solved the complex math problem.
Using the Pythagorean Theorem, the complex math problem solved itself easily.
Being solved easily, the complex math problem used the Pythagorean Theorem.
Easily solving the complex math problem, the Pythagorean Theorem was used.

questions.explanation: Placing the logical subject ('the student'—who actually used the theorem) directly after the introductory participial phrase corrects the dangling modifier.

questions.question: ______ the regional water bureau completed the watershed restoration project, severe soil erosion had already swept away tons of fertile topsoil.
questions.explanation: 'By the time' introduces a time clause indicating that an event occurred prior to another past milestone (paired with Past Perfect 'had already swept away').

questions.question: In Section 4C.1, why are leguminous trees specifically highlighted as crucial components of sustainable agroforestry systems?

options.text: Because of their unique biological ability to fix atmospheric nitrogen and enrich soil fertility for surrounding crops.
Because they produce synthetic chemical herbicides naturally.
Because they eliminate the need for rainfall or irrigation in dry regions.
Because they prevent wild animals from entering agricultural fields.

questions.explanation: Section 4C.1 notes that leguminous trees fix atmospheric nitrogen into the soil, naturally replenishing soil nutrients and reducing dependence on chemical fertilizers.

questions.question: When structuring a five-paragraph expository essay on the environmental impacts of human activities on natural resources, what function must the body paragraphs serve?

options.text: Presenting distinct supporting evidence, specific cause-and-effect relationships, and logical data analysis governed by topic sentences.
Introducing fictional dialogue between imaginary characters.
Restating the thesis statement in every single line without adding new information.
Listing emotional personal complaints without factual backing.

questions.explanation: In expository essay writing (Section 4F.2), body paragraphs develop the central claim using topic sentences, factual evidence, logical cause-and-effect reasoning, and objective data analysis.
